Lemma
[Kernel of the linearized map-Laplacian on the sphere] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0283, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0284 ↗ rem:chow-iv-sphere-map-laplacian-low-eigenspaces 1. ch34:34.8\group Harmonic Maps on Spheres

For the unit sphere, $\ker L_{g_{\mathrm{sph}}}$ is the space dual to the Killing vector fields if $n\ge 3$, and is the space dual to the conformal Killing vector fields if $n=2$.
Proof

\sketch For every vector field $W$ on a closed manifold, integration by parts and commutation of derivatives give Yano’s identity

\[ -\int _M\langle L_gW,W\rangle =\frac12\int _M\left|\mathcal L_Wg-\frac2n(\operatorname {div}W)g\right|^2 -\left(1-\frac2n\right)\int _M|\operatorname {div}W|^2. \]

When $n=2$, this identifies the kernel with conformal Killing fields. When $n\ge 3$, the spectral description in Remark 2 makes a kernel element coclosed, hence divergence-free, and the identity makes it Killing. Conversely, taking the divergence of the Killing equation yields $\Delta _gW+\Rc (W)=0$, so every Killing field lies in the kernel.

□
